title: Trent Wakenight (Marker Ninja) graphic-recorded the Responsive Conference keynote: 'Culture Bank,' 'mission statement ≠ mission,' 'crushed by the weight of corruption'
summary: Trent Wakenight, founder of Marker Ninja, live-illustrated Eric's Responsive Conference keynote with Jamie Lynn White and published the full graphic recording. The single panel captures most of the talk's spine: financial gravity, the Culture Bank, mission statement ≠ mission, the invisible leader, 'what would the CFO do?', and the closing call for collective action.
blockquote: What a treat! Last week, I got to record a presentation by Eric Ries, lean startup expert at the Responsive Conference in Oakland. Check out his new book "Incorruptible"!
